Meta.title: SABMER — Mitsubishi lift installation
Meta.description: Subcontractor installing Mitsubishi lifts: stage bet — fitting the equipment, stage gimel — commissioning and handover. Over five years in the trade. Hiring fitters.

Hero.sub: End-to-end subcontracting: from fitting the equipment to handing the lift over in service.

About.title: About
About.text: SABMER is a subcontractor installing Mitsubishi lifts. Over five years in the trade. We carry a site through two stages:

stages.s1: Stage bet — fitting the equipment: cab, doors, machine, counterweight and guide rails
stages.s2: Stage gimel — after commissioning: preparing the shaft, running the cables, final adjustment and handover
stages.s3: We are hiring fitters — the terms are under “Work”

Founders.title: Founders
Founders.amirBio: Over seven years in the lift trade. Looks after clients, contracts and the growth of the company.
Founders.vovaBio: Over seven years in the lift trade. Trained as a site foreman at a university in Khabarovsk. Looks after installation method, crew training and quality on site.
